quirks.condition: A load whose version tag is Z0.
quirks.effect: The blob is accepted with its pairs split on commas instead of semicolons, and the checksum is computed over the Z0 body; the serializer only ever emits Z1. The spec rejects any tag other than Z1 with R VER.

quirks.condition: A loaded blob contains the same key more than once.
quirks.effect: The load is accepted; the key keeps the position and spelling of its first occurrence and takes the value of its last occurrence. The spec rejects duplicates with R FMT.

quirks.condition: The first serialize after a load that was a Z0 blob or that collapsed duplicate keys.
quirks.effect: The live insertion order is rebuilt in ascending alphabetical key order before the blob is written, and that order stays as the baseline for later commands; serializes after any other load keep insertion order.

quirks.condition: Serializing a value of exactly 12 characters.
quirks.effect: The blob writes only the first 10 characters of the value, with the checksum computed over the truncated bytes, so the blob validates but reloading it loses the last 2 characters; G still returns all 12. Values of 11 or fewer characters are written in full.

quirks.condition: A loaded blob contains keys that differ only in letter case.
quirks.effect: The loader treats them as one key for duplicate collapsing (first spelling and position, last value), while live P and G stay case-sensitive.

quirks.condition: A load of a blob with a correct checksum and an empty pair section (Z1||checksum).
quirks.effect: The load is accepted, the live state is cleared, and the reply is OK 0. The spec requires at least one pair and rejects R FMT.
The OK count reports the number of pairs present in the blob before duplicate collapsing, not the number of live keys afterwards.

quirks.condition: A P or G command with extra tokens after the documented ones.
quirks.effect: The extra tokens are ignored and the command is processed; the spec rejects them as malformed.

unmapped_families.reason: Held-out mixed corpus exercising every quirk together with spec-accurate paths; no single quirk maps to it.
